chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub narrated from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Hammad, from al-Halabi, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about ghusl when one has performed the ramy of the jimar. He said: I have perhaps done it at times, but as for the sunnah, then no; rather, it is because of the heat and sweat.

key_terms.الْجِمَارَ: the pebbled pillars ritually stoned during hajj

ai.seo_question: Is ghusl after ramy al-jimar during hajj part of the sunnah?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses whether ghusl is prescribed after performing the ramy of the jimar during hajj. Imam Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام states that although he may sometimes have done so, it is not from the sunnah, but rather due to heat and perspiration.
